entries.comment: Article 298 septies of the general tax code
Publications of general interest with a direct connection to current affairs

Applies to newspaper of the newspaper publisher which has the status of a medium, published daily, other than those that contain, in whole or for the most part, advertisements or serve for advertising, and other than those that contain, in whole or for the most part, video recording or music content.

Applies to newspapers and periodicals of a newspaper publisher with the status of a medium, as well as those for which there is no obligation to issue the medium status under special regulation, other than those referred to in paragraph 2 item g) of Article 38, issued periodically and other than those that contain, in whole or for the most part, advertisements or serve for advertising, and other than those that contain, in whole or for the most part, video recording or music content.
